name: stream-board-games-mobile
description: Android app shell (Capacitor) around the board games overlay: play against bots or with phones on the same WiFi, touch input, over-the-air game updates.
//: shell: raise it whenever the native side changes (a Capacitor plugin, permissions, prepare-android.mjs): over-the-air updates built for a newer shell are not applied to older APKs. updateUrl: where GitHub Pages publishes the app's files (forks: point at your own Pages).

scripts.android:init: npx cap add android && node prepare-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
